🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 12, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a trine to Jupiter, in Leo. Two fire placements agreeing on the terms: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, meeting no resistance. Fire moves first here, and first is enough. Two weeks ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. From Scorpio, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Since Venus crossed out of Scorpio, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Sagittarius, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable air: keeping options is the expense. The conjunction to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Sagittarius, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Sagittarius, Moon concedes the point early. Fire keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and the cost objects. Earth adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Retrograde since three weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. Moon in Sagittarius opens a gap you have to step into. Air that starts things, started cheaply. The hold Moon had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds until owning and being coincide. In four weeks Mars has moved 14°, small enough to feel like nothing.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Mutable fire: both answers turn out to be one answer. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. Three weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Sagittarius, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. The trine of three weeks ago is off it now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Sagittarius, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable water keeps two accounts open and pays both. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.
